description: 英音口語中，字中或字尾的 /t/ 經常由聲帶瞬間閉合截斷氣流代替，產生特有的頓音節奏。

examples.text: Can I have a bottle of water, please?
It is not quite that important.
I will get it sorted right now.

category: Linking 'r' & Intrusive 'r' (英音連音 r 與侵入性 r)
description: 英式非捲舌音中，當前詞以 r 結尾且後詞以元音起音時需連讀；若兩詞無 r 但為元音過渡，母語者會自然插入 /r/ 音。

examples.text: Law and order is essential for society.
There are four eggs in the fridge.
The idea of going to the cinema sounds lovely.

description: 英語是重音等時節奏語言，介詞、助動詞如 to, for, can, been 在自然語流中一律弱化為中元音 /ə/。

examples.text: I have been waiting for the bus for an hour.
You can come to our house tomorrow.
Would you like a cup of tea?

description: 標準英音（SSBE/RP）中，bath, ask, fast, path 讀開闊後長音 /ɑː/，切勿讀成美音扁平的 /æ/。

examples.text: I need to take a quick bath before we leave.
Could I ask you for a fast response?
Follow the path through the grass to the gate.
